nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor and mutable through setOwner.
Percentage (default 1) of every transfer that is burned, used to compute toBurn.
Counter of registered hodlers stored in the hodlers array-mapping; incremented on new holder registration.
Hard supply cap of 1000 * 10**18 used to bound reward minting.
Mapping(uint256 => address) that indexes all registered hodler addresses.
Mapping(address => Hodler) used to check whether an address is already registered as a hodler.
ERC20 private balance mapping mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20 total supply, read by _valueToMint and _rewardHodlers to compute remaining mintable amount.
ERC20 nested allowance mapping written by _approve and read by transferFrom/burnFrom.
HodlerToken constructor: sets owner, mints 100 tokens, registers owner as first hodler and increments totalHodlers.
Public owner transfer function guarded by the _onlyOwner modifier.
Overridden transfer: burns burnRatio% of value, forwards the rest, registers the recipient as hodler and rewards existing hodlers.
Overridden transferFrom: burns part of value via burnFrom, registers recipient, updates allowance and rewards hodlers.
Private redistribution routine: iterates over hodlers, computes totalBalance and mints proportional rewards while supply remains.
Public view returning min(10**18, maxSupply - totalSupply()), the amount minted per reward round.
View helper using extcodesize assembly to filter out contract hodlers during reward distribution.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; sole access control gate for privileged operations.
Context helper returning msg.sender, used as the effective caller in ERC20 functions.
ERC20 internal _transfer performing balance bookkeeping and emitting Transfer.
ERC20 internal _burn reducing holder balance and total supply.
ERC20 internal _mint increasing total supply and recipient balance; called in a loop by _rewardHodlers.
ERC20 internal _approve writing the allowance mapping.
Public burn(uint256) burning from _msgSender() through _burn.
Public burnFrom(address,uint256) reducing allowance and burning on behalf of another account.
Public view reading the _allowances mapping.
Empty ERC20 hook invoked before every transfer, mint and burn.
Address library helper performing a low-level .call{value:} to an arbitrary target with arbitrary data.
Address library helper forwarding all gas with .call{value: amount}("") to an arbitrary recipient.
Attacker-controlled caller identity used for ownership checks, transfers and burning.
State-changing external-visible mint executed for every hodler inside an unbounded loop over totalHodlers.
Low-level call forwarding all gas and value to an arbitrary address before any state finalization, reentrancy surface.
Raw subtraction maxSupply - totalSupply() performed without SafeMath, relied upon for reward gating.
Address argument of setOwner used as the new owner value.
Recipient argument of transfer; also used as hodler registration key.
Amount argument of transfer from which toBurn and finalValue are derived.
Local computed burn amount = _value * burnRatio / 100 in transfer.
Local forwarded amount = _value - toBurn in transfer.
Local reward pool returned by _valueToMint inside _rewardHodlers.
Local accumulator of eligible hodler balances used as reward denominator.
Per-hodler minted reward = toMint * balance / totalBalance.
Source address argument of transferFrom used for burnFrom and reward exclusion.
Amount argument of the public burn function.
Account whose tokens are burned by burnFrom after allowance deduction.
Loop-local hodler address read from the hodlers mapping during reward distribution.
Loop-local balanceOf(hodler) used to weight the reward.
Local reduced allowance computed in burnFrom before re-approval.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to the owner state variable inside the _onlyOwner modifier.
_onlyOwner gates whether setOwner executes for the calling msg.sender.
setOwner writes the trusted owner state variable.
Constructor initializes owner with the deployer identity.
msg.sender becomes the privileged owner during construction.
Constructor mints the initial token supply via _mint.
Constructor registers the owner as first hodler and increments totalHodlers.
transfer reads burnRatio to compute the burn amount.
transfer forwards to the ERC20 _transfer internal routine.
transfer burns the computed fee through super.burn/_burn.
transfer adds a new hodler and increments totalHodlers.
transfer triggers _rewardHodlers after moving tokens.
msg.sender is the implicit sender of the overridden transfer.
transferFrom delegates balance movement to ERC20 _transfer.
transferFrom burns the fee fraction via _burn.
transferFrom registers new hodlers and increments totalHodlers.
transferFrom calls _rewardHodlers after the transfer.
transferFrom reads/derives allowances through the allowance view path.
_rewardHodlers reads maxSupply to bound reward minting.
maxSupply - totalSupply() raw subtraction determines whether rewards are minted.
_rewardHodlers queries _valueToMint for the reward pool size.
_rewardHodlers calls isContract to filter contract holders.
_rewardHodlers mints a proportional reward to each eligible hodler.
Unbounded loop over totalHodlers performing repeated mint state changes.
_valueToMint computes remaining supply from _totalSupply.
_burn decreases the holder balance in _balances.
_mint increases the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath addition.
_transfer updates sender and recipient balances.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Public burn destroys caller tokens through _burn.
burnFrom re-approves the decreased allowance via _approve.
burnFrom burns the target account tokens.
burnFrom reads the current allowance before deduction.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom updates the spender allowance after moving tokens.
_functionCallWithValue executes a gas-forwarding low-level call to an arbitrary target.
sendValue forwards all gas and value to an untrusted recipient.
External low-level call returns control to the callee, enabling reentrant entry before state finalization.
_msgSender returns the raw msg.sender value.
transfer resolves the effective caller through _msgSender.
Public burn resolves the burner through _msgSender.

normalization_plan.reason: The _address parameter only exists to be written into the owner state variable by setOwner.
The _to parameter is a pure transfer argument used for balance and hodler-registry writes in transfer.
The _value parameter only feeds the burn/finalValue arithmetic of transfer.
toBurn is a transient arithmetic local entirely local to the transfer implementation.
finalValue is a transient arithmetic local entirely local to the transfer implementation.
The _from parameter is only consumed by the transferFrom allowance/burn logic.
The amount parameter is only used to call _burn for the caller in burn.
The account parameter is only used for allowance deduction and burning in burnFrom.
decreasedAllowance is an intermediate allowance value consumed only by burnFrom.
toMint is the reward pool local produced and consumed solely inside the reward routine.
totalBalance is an accumulator used only for the proportional reward math.
reward is the per-hodler minted amount computed and immediately consumed in the loop.
hodler is a loop-local address handle read from the hodlers mapping.
balance is a loop-local balance used only to weight the reward mint.
